renders._yaml:
- component: advanced_viz
  id: distribution_composition
  title: Read distribution over the annotation
  description: |-
    Each bar is a library, split into the share of its mapped tags that fall on each part of the annotation: exons, introns, promoter and downstream bands and intergenic sequence. It answers where the reads of each library land.
    How to read: an RNA-seq library of mature RNA is dominated by exonic reads. A high intronic share points to pre-mRNA or genomic DNA contamination, and a high intergenic share to DNA contamination or an incomplete annotation. Switch the level to read the individual features.
    Note: where features overlap, RSeQC assigns a read to CDS exons first, then UTR exons, then introns, then intergenic regions.
    Source: https://rseqc.sourceforge.net/ and https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22743226/
  kind: stacked_bar
  config:
    default_rank: Region class
    rank_label: Level
    x_title: Library
    value_title: Share of mapped tags
  roles:
    sample_id: sample_id
    taxon: taxon
    rank: rank
    abundance: abundance

- component: card
  title: Mapped tags by region class
  description: |-
    The hero number is the total count of mapped tags over all libraries, with the median and the largest class beside it, and the bar splits them by region class. It answers what share of the sequencing falls on exons, introns and intergenic regions.
    How to read: a mostly exonic bar is the expected shape for mature RNA. A large intergenic or intronic share is the lead for contamination or an annotation that misses real transcripts.
    Source: https://rseqc.sourceforge.net/
  column: tag_count
  aggregation: sum
  aggregations:
  - median
  - max
  secondary_layout: composition
  breakdown_col: region_class
  filter_expr: col('rank') == 'Region class'
  caption: tags, by region class
  headline: true

- component: table
  title: Read distribution table
  description: |-
    Each row is a library and an annotation class, at the region level or at the feature level, with its tag count and its share of the library. It answers the exact counts behind the composition.
    How to read: filter the rank to Region class for the coarse split, or Feature for the exon, UTR, promoter and downstream bands.
